t:
Oh! Karah-Oki is the most useful thing invented by the Waterfolk aside from the Hurricane cocktail.
Legend has it that the origin of Karah-Oki is associated with Oki the Thunderous, the most loud-voiced singer, and the Great Turtle who is peacefully sleeping at the bottom of the ocean. Oki knew only one song. But what a song it was! You could say it's our anthem! When he sang - he always sang when he was drunk, and Oki drank like a fish - you could hear him far beyond the island. Poor Oki's loud singing really got on the Great Turtle's nerves. She became angry and punished him. The old woman cast oblivion on poor Oki, and he forgot the words of our only song! What a tragedy... But that didn't stop us! We wrote the words of the song on boards and showed them to Oki whenever he started singing.
In the end, the Turtle forgave Oki, and everything ended well. And singing when you have lyrics showed to you? It stuck, and we named it Karah-Oki!
Do you want to participate? I'll handle the music and you will sing. You can do it! I believe in you.
Don't know the lyrics? Not a problem! Just watch me when you sing. I will show you the lyrics, so you can sing heartily without having to worry about anything. There are no bad songs, just bad listeners!
Just don't get carried away, otherwise it won't take long to get hoarse from Karah-Oki

Want to race my crabs? My pleasure. Don't be too disappointed if you lose, tho.
To boost you just a bit, I'll give you a rocket. You'll fly over the water, the crabs will run on feet. But they'll be ahead anyway, no one has beaten them so far. Try and catch the tailwind with the rocket, it'll help. And if you do outfly them - which, to tell you the truth, I sincerely doubt - I will give you a good reward!

Welcome to Currency Exchange!
Remember that exchange rates may vary depending on demand and supply.
I also have mercenary contracts, aha! Any whim can be satisfied for a payment!
Mercenaries are the same everywhere. You receive a contract, summon a mercenary, and they fight on your side until the contract expires.
They just won't stop making a mess, will they?

So, you want to save the innocent victim? How generous and kind of you! But before you rush to slaughter the lizards, let me give you a piece of advice.
The Altar and its guardians are protected by unknown and strange spell. With every single lizard slain, these protective powers weaken. You will see it yourself when you slay at least a dozen of them. If you manage to break their defenses, you will save the innocent victim and get the reward.
But you are not the only hero willing to save the girl. There are others who will try to get in your way using a special ability that pushes the competitors back from the victim. You can use it against your opponents, too, but every time you do so, the defenses will grow stronger, and you will have to kill the lizards again. Anyway, your rival's situation will become even worse...
Don't waste your time if you want to save the girl. Better let someone else do the job instead of leaving her to die!
Mausoleum of Sparks is waiting for you!
Hello seeker... Are you looking for truth and power? Don't try to fool me, I can see the hunger for glory in your eyes. With Master's permission I'll help you to meet your dreams!

Trial of Bravery is your chance to earn glory in a ruthless battle, a chance to write your name into the list of Sarnaut's greatest heroes!
If you want to participate, gather your most faithful and experienced friends.
You will need the Shining Key to teleport into the Mausoleum of Sparks, an ancient structure created by Tep himself.
Tep used this Mausoleum for sacrifices. He extracted sparks from the bodies of his victims and placed them into his dreadful mechanisms to perform extraordinary magic!
The first mechanism can heal any wound after a spark absorption. The second one provides protection and speeds up the regeneration of magical powers. Using the third mechanism, you can feel a burst of energy embodied in a spark - your attacks will gain power and the energy will restore much quicker.
Our Master discovered the Mausoleum in the Astral depths and organized this Trial to find the strongest fighters.
Touch the stele in the center of the Mausoleum to start the Trial. Enemies will be coming in waves, you need to hold on as long as you can!

I'm quite useful! I know a lot, and I can do a lot! I'll tell you everything!

Don't hit me!
Hmm. I don't usually take prisoners, but one of these scoundrels might be useful. If worst comes to worst, we'll have someone to execute!
Like you don't know. None of your business.
Enough of that! Stop distracting me! Or I'm gonna hit you!

On women and booze, of course! Caligula has the hottest girls! Time to visit Skewer!

It will be done soon. Grot will be pleased, and the order will be fulfilled.
Yes, but he still owes me some!
Go away! Get in line, you all!
Enough! We've been here for so long, and I have to cook for you idiots!
Riot, you say? Who's with us?
Take a guess. He got a rich customer...
Huh, that bastard. Made up a story about debt thinking he could fool everyone!
Money? How about I give you this!
Have you been chewing on the local mushrooms? Grot will rip you apart and feed you to his beasts. Get out of here, instigator!
No... They are loyal to Grot, because he pays well, and this is a big order. It won't work! Now get out of here before they hang us!
I don't, but if I did, I wouldn't tell you. What if you're working for the competition, trying to steal our order? Go away, eavesdropper!

That guy? Pfft... No, there's a bigger fish. Grot went pale in the face when he mentioned that one. He's not afraid of the goblin.

Listen... I've had enough of this talk! Others will come begging for food now! And you're in the way, so get out.
Hey, did you make it all up? The debt? So you could pit us against each other? I'll show you!
I'm going to hit you so you leave me alone!
What?! I owe him? Why would he think so? What's your proof?
That bastard! Maybe I should add pepper to his food. He's lying, that dog!
It's Grunt. Maybe you should ask him about the debt? Just start with a code phrase: "Evil maiden sank to the bottom"! Don't forget.
Debts? Let's see, let's see... He doesn't owe anyone anything.
You? Who are you? Get out!
Let him come, then. Why are you here? Are you an idiot? Here!
The rest? We'll be paid when we're done with the job. Like he doesn't know. What has he been eating in his kitchen? Mushrooms?
Is he an idiot? People like that aren't cheap - it's not some Izune bandit!

So mistrustful. But oh well. I only heard half of it when the captain was speaking to him... to her, I mean. Our customer is Victoria Korleone, the head of the drug mafia that ate up all competition on Igsh, Suslanger, and Yakhch! She deals in psi-salt, which sells well these days. Quite a terrifying lady, worse than Tep, they say! But she keeps her word, so tell him not to worry, he'll be paid.

I can trade Core Morphers for Core Storage Shards! Do you want to trade?
No problem. You can use a Petrified Core to change your class or a Core Impression to return to your current class. The quality is guaranteed by the company!
A Core Impression? Why don't you use the core that you already have in the first place? I want to see it. What if you're a spy?
A Core Impression? Why don't you use the core that you already have in the first place? I want to see it. You look suspicious. What if you're a spy?
No problem. You can use a Petrified Core to change your class or a Core Impression to return to your default class. The quality is guaranteed by the company!
I can trade Core Morphers for Core Storage Shards!

Do you want to obtain an Omnificent Core Morpher? It is a rarity indeed.

Here, take this Wand. It will help you transform Petrified Cores and Core Storage into Shards of an Omnificent Core Morpher. 5 shards can be combined into an Omnificent Core Morpher that will allow you to change your class to any other anytime you want!

I can exchange any Petrified Core for 1 Shard of an Omnificent Core Morpher. 5 shards can be combined into an Omnificent Core Morpher that will allow you to change your class to any other anytime you want!
I can trade Petrified Cores for Core Storage Shards!
You're easy to deal with. Here you are!
I trade pages for sections, sections for parts, parts for the whole Edict of Conclave. What would you like to trade?

This Ark is a true miracle! Trust me, I know something about miracles!

There are two Scrolls in the Ark. Read the first one to instantly reach level 115 and get all rubies and abilities available only to the mightiest heroes of Sarnaut.

Read the second Scroll to get a full set of rare equipment. The Ark also contains Droplets of Water of Life and Death to help you get used to your new abilities.

This Ark is a true miracle! Trust me, I know something about miracles!

There are two Scrolls in the Ark. Read the first one to instantly reach level 115 and get all rubies and abilities available only to the mightiest heroes of Sarnaut.

Read the second Scroll to get a full set of rare equipment. The Ark also contains a complete set of level 5 Runes, Droplets of Water of Life and Death to help you get used to your new abilities, a Twilight Wolf's collar for fast traveling around the world, a roomy Dragon Hide Backpack, a 36-slot Safe Deposit Box, and a 25-page Quest Log! Not to mention a significant amount of gold. Isn't that everything a hero needs?
If you want to stay in touch with me all the time, I can give you my scroll in exchange for a Vial of Condensed Water of Death or a Sealed Vial of Condensed Water of Death. Deal?
Perfect. Now you can use my services even in the deepest Astral.

t: How can I be of help?

Yes, it's me! And who are you? The queen sent you?

Those vipers are keeping me here! Their commander threw me here. They didn't say what they wanted...

Listen, help me! When they caught me, they damaged my wing, so I can't fly anymore! Take me to the palace, please!

You... How do you know about the Destroyers' relic? Now you will not escape death. Even if you win this combat, other Destroyers will come and kill you. But I, Kaid, promised to answer your question and I will keep my word. The Bowl is in our Temple. It connects us with our origins and gives us strength which is unattainable for the mortals. Only those who prove to be worthy can touch it. And you are not one of them.

Prepare to die!

Greetings, Seeker of Truth. I see doubt in your eyes.
What bothers you?
I understand your concerns. No, I haven't seen the people you describe. I doubt they are that brave or that stupid to approach the Citadel after they refused to follow the Master's law.

Yes, I know who you are talking about. We've captured some bandits recently, they tried to sneak into the Citadel. They called themselves Treasure Seekers. We reduced them to dust.
I doubt that anyone else would risk their lives trying to repeat their mistake.
Those who violate the Master's law will be slain!

System diagnostics... Affirmative. Oil change request... Submitted. Request proceeded.
Warning: violation of safety rules! Static electricity! To prevent sparks use antistatic agent immediately!
System test negative. No oil replacement needed.

Integral is giving people its rare metals.
People have to leave the system now. Integral is searching for an answer to the main question about reason for being, living et cetera. Estimated operating time: 368164 hours.

Whatever you wish for your money, uh-huh.
Here they are, talk to them!
Alright, off you go. We'll meet again soon, anyway...
Alright, off you go. We'll meet again soon, anyway...
Isn’t he cutey cute? So fluffy, so soft, and look at his whiskers! And paws, and tail! Want to pat him, don’t you?
Do you want to try skating?

You want to join the festive procession in honor of Genlun? Oh, it’s a great honor for us!
The procession takes place every hour, when the Priestess appears in the temple. She must bring a special divine tea to Genlun - to warm his cold-blooded body and grant prosperity to our land! The Priestess is accompanied by the Dragon and Drummer who ward off evil spirits. They are followed by Dancers who support their spirit! That’s what your role will be.

Keep pace with the Priestess and the rest. Cheer them up, and everything will go smoothly!
The event has not started yet.
Oh, it will be difficult... But not for an experienced huntress like me! I can catch it for you - but not for free... Just a couple of snowflakes, and the Owlet is yours.
Come back when you have snowflakes!
You must learn to control Snow Owls first. Come back when you raise an Owl.
Oh, it will be difficult... But not for an experienced huntress like me! I can catch it for you - but not for free... Just a couple of snowflakes, and the bird is yours.
You must learn to control Ice Jays first. Come back when you raise a Jay.
Yes, it's our new attraction! It's called exactly that - the Winter Hunt. You can go for a ride or test your accuracy!
Take this, it will help you locate their nests in the snow.
Take this, it will help you locate their nests in the snow.

You can tame one of those at our resort! Unfortunately, if you approach an adult specimen, it will probably peck you to death. They do not like strangers. So if you want to tame a jay or an owl, you will have to find an egg or a very young fledgling, and then raise it yourself.

Welcome to our village! Here anyone can find an entertainment to their liking. Figure skating, snowball tournaments, fishing, delicious food, and beautiful fireworks are all here for you. No violence is admitted: in our resort, we don't bear arms even against our worst enemies!

Enjoy yourself, have fun, and don't forget to buy a souvenir!
The machine hums, mysterious sparks run over its surface.
Action can be performed. Confirm readiness. Hold on tight.
Less talk, more walk! Go to the East, you might find something there.
I did see it, so what? Why should I help you? Look for it by yourselves! Try Eastern edge, I say, under the box. See, how kind I am today?
The spirit waxes indignant over your loss of such a valuable artifact. Nevertheless, he gives you another Charm.
The spirit waxes indignant over your loss of such a valuable artifact. Nevertheless, he gives you another Charm.
The spirit waxes indignant over your loss of such a valuable artifact. Nevertheless, he gives you another Charm.
The spirit waxes indignant over your loss of such a valuable artifact. Nevertheless, he gives you another Charm.
Oh shure, of high importance, tell me! It mustabeen Cath'rina who sent you! And Yaska baked you a pie, togetha with Addinas, rye? Leave me alone, before I break your neck!
Alas! The master is sure to kill Mart, he will! Ah well, anyways, come on in, you bloody lunatics! What for are we paying the price of having you here?
Why should I? Who are you, anyways? First it was this foolish girs, now you! Want my knowledge? I’m gonna teach you something!
Everything ready? Let’s start cooking then. Do you know, at least, how to approach the cauldron?
Here, take it. Don’t lose it again.
I will tell you everything you need to know as an Olympics participant. Ask away!

Besides the seasonal Olympics, there are also intermediate Two-Weeks’ Competitions. For two weeks, we record the best results you achieve in the trials during that time, and at the end of that period, you will receive rewards based on your accomplishments. After that, the rating will be reset, and the competition will start anew.

Don’t worry about your seasonal results - they will be stored until the end of the Olympics.

The reward for the Two-Weeks’ Competition in the seasonal Olympics is Dionic Olympics Emblems. You can spend these emblems to purchase certain rewards from me.

Absolutely everyone will receive Emblems for participation, but the quantity depends on your position in the ranking. Players with the best results will earn special achievements and titles.

Dionic Olympics are held 4 times a year, and each season lasts 3 months.

During a season, we record your best results in trials, then add them up to calculate your total score in the Olympics.

At the end of the season, we sum up the results and reward the winners who have scored the most points in the overall Olympics rankings. Once another Olympics start, the rankings are reset, and the competition starts anew.

You will find the Olympic competition schedule in your calendar.

Winter Olympics start on December 1, and the scores are calculated on March 1.

Spring Olympics start on March 1 and end on June 1.

Summer Olympics are held from June 1 to September 1.

Fall Olympics - from September 1 to December 1.

But that’s not all!

Besides the seasonal Olympics, there are also intermediate Two-Weeks’ Competitions, where you get a separate reward depending on your score.
I have recorded all your scores in trials. Which rating are you interested in?
Dionic Olympics are where the true champions of Dionic Games meet!
Isn't it gorgeous? This spectral ball is glorious and evasive. It's hard to catch it while you play Air Triathlon. I consider it the symbol of a true champion!

First, you must prove yourself worthy of wearing this symbol of swiftness and aspiration!

Complete Phoebus' quest "Dionic Games: Challenge for a Champion" and return to me.
Greetings! How can I be of use?
Here you are. Make sure you don't lose it again.
Which reward would you like to receive?

Do you want to feel the taste of real Skirmishes? Battles, where not only rough force matters, but also thoughtful tactical planning?

Then you belong on Dominion, where the best guild raids battle for the Astral treasures! The more successful your guild is, the more Realgar it gets as the reward. And the more is your personal benefit!

The sword of Citovras, the leader of Centaurs, who fell in battle with Sarnaut heroes. It's a reminder to the Spiral Ridge tribe about the importance of careful selection of allies, because even the strongest of this world risk being dominated by dark powers.
These ancient June ruins are overflowing with magic...
These ancient June ruins are overflowing with magic...

Trade complete!
Now use the Talk-back Device to speak to Wormface representative.
You hear clicking and humming from the Talk-back Device.

We, the Overmind, hope that you as a distinguished member of your tribe will see the true value of our gift. Now go. You made us face a tough choice. We are having new issues we have to think about. Remember, you are our friend now. We are always happy to help someone who sincerely searches knowledge!

You proved that you were honest and unselfish. You help others and don't ask for rewards... You must be either stupid or generous. I think you are generous.
That's why WE, the Overmind, decided to reward you. Take your reward from the exchange container.
Shaky steps lead into the dark depths of the cave.

It can't be... You defeated the spirit of the Great Dragon. Finally one of the greatest June Hunters is avenged...
I understand you did it not because of revenge. It's a symbolic act, enemies who fought each other for centuries now rest in peace.
Maybe in future we and Draconids will overcome the consequences of this bloodshed. Thank you. Go now, we must think your words over.
This container is used to trade various items with the Wormfaces
Used to teleport you to your Astral Ship in the Hangar.
Portal to the Mausoleum of Sparks. You need a Shining Key to use it.
I will help you bind your Adventurer's Stone to this location.

You don't have enough money to do that.

The world starts spinning around. You are flying through space!
Used to control minds of the cultists. Must be charged before use.

The shell of this egg is unbelievably hard. It's too tough for a hammer or an axe. Even a diamond drill (which you don't have anyway) is unlikely to crack it. Yet there must be a way to destroy these eggs!
This egg is broken! I wonder how that happened?
Hmm... The eggs shell is hard below, yet at the top it is soft and crumbles easily. Looks like somebody poured some strong acid on this egg first, and then broke it.
Wormface's body is wearing some sort of armor. Looks like the draconids caught him in the act as he was trying to destroy their eggs.
All right! You find a vial with remains of pure acid on the wormface's body. He has no use for it anymore. Looks like acid is the best way to break this hard shell.
Looks like it is possible to get to the surface through this portal.
An old June teleport, seriously damaged yet still operational. They sure knew how to build stuff in the olden times!
Are you sure you want to bind to this location?
Fiery symbols on the sides of the device suggest that this is a common teleport. Though it does look strange...
The entrance is closed and none but ghosts can enter.
This place is dark and creepy... Mold and mustiness drift from the depths of the pyramid.
The portal is literally swathed in a powerful magic aura...
I will help you bind your Adventurer's Stone to this location.
You can't feed the insatiable Guardian? Our gracious Master allowed me to open a portal for you, but you must pay for it - this is a tradition everyone must respect.
You don't have enough money to do that.
Here, I'll cast a spell on you that'll allow you to understand the needs of the portal guardian.
What vile tools these necromancers use... For instance, this totem is coated with a thick layer of dried blood.
There's a light buzzing in the air.
The whole world disappears in a bright flash.
A strange corpse... Better get a closer look.
Steps of the stairs are wiped with thousands of feet...
Hopefully no one is ambushing you at the outside!

Stop-stop-stop! Argh, Sarn, you never change!
Always trying to get someone else to do your dirty work... Didn't the whole June incident teach you anything?
Not to mention your power is weak! All you can do is run your mouth. Now shut up! It's time I give you a piece of my mind.

Sarn is devious, to be sure... Using the enemy's weapon against them is something new. So then, he decided to stage another "Revelation" for you? Ha-ha. So naive...
Here's what I'll tell you, friend. My light-oriented mate was almost fully truthful about the Seals. Almost. Because power is always power, and the only difference is how you use it.
Did you talk to the cultists? "By the name of the Light Sarn... Oh, Sarn, may you protect us... Oh, Benevolent Sarn"... Pah! Disgusting. Brainless dummies! Tell me, did you ever charge into battle shouting my name? What is it that leads you to battle: my irrefutable word or your own curiosity? Would you lay down your life if I order it? Well, these puppets would, and gladly I might add. There...
See you at the Citadel. I have things to say, to be sure.

And another thing. About power and its application.
Did it ever occur to you why is it that Sarn's minions cannot resurrect like everyone else? And don't give me that crap about how "it's unnatural, it's an enemy gift, blah-blah-blah..." Although, there's something to it being an enemy gift. The Power of Light is your power. The power of your faith. You were directed to this faith by Tensess. And who do you think was standing by Tensess' side when his Spark left his body? Who gave this Power to Tensess himself? Who taught him to make all the inhabitants of Sarnaut believe in their own immortality? Come on, take a guess! Sarn? Wrong... The great dragon? Wrong again... The twelve "great martyrs"? Hah! Or was it me? Ding, ding, ding!
It was me who gave the first push to make the whole world believe in the Power of Light. Why did I do it? I'd rather not answer that question yet. For now let's just say I was in a charitable mood. I wanted to equalize the odds between allods inhabitants and astral demons. You know how I like fair play.
Consider my words, mortal. Or should I say, "immortal"?
Now you've turned another page in the history of the world. History that's being written before your very eyes, mortal!

Greetings, mortal! Your persistence and desire to learn the truth about the things going on around you demand respect. Not many dare to set out on the path of truth. In fact, most prefer to live like grass, focused on momentary desires, paying no mind to the past or the future or even of the present.
I assume you already know a great deal... But there is more, much more! So open and prepare your soul for what you are about to hear.
Everywhere you turn people say, "Sarn wants to destroy the world, Sarn only created you to kill you!" But think! You wouldn't even exist if not for me. There would be no war, no sweet brew, no astral ships - Nothingness would be your sole reality. But you live, you feel, and you think. Your flesh and your Spark were created by me! And it is only I who can grant you Salvation. When there's nothing left of Sarnaut, the worlds beyond shall only open to those who are faithful to me. And to no one else!
With the Twelve Great Seals Nihaz once sealed Sarnaut... my prison. The Black Obelisk is a fragment of one of them, and but a small reflection of the powers that had chained me at the dawn of life. The seal had split in the Cataclysm, and a fraction of its power spilt into the world. The power it contains is shadow, darkness and murk. But long before the Cataclysm a powerful sorcerer you know as Tep discovered the nature of this power and used it to create his greatest Plague.
Even now the Black Obelisk remains a trap for all things living. It is pure darkness. A darkness which absorbs any light whole, even the light of your Sparks. That is the true face of Nihaz! Destruction is his name!
Do you know why wormfaces and draconids committed their betrayal? I can tell you why...

I waited for you, mortal. My name is Sarn!
Don't be afraid. I am here to talk to you

I know that you serve my ancient enemy, Nihaz. That is why I am addressing you, mortal.
The direct path to the Dead City is no more. It is blocked by madmen, who dared to repudiate all gods and now hope to cheat fate itself. They won't succeed, you can be sure of that. Sooner or later, either me or my mortal enemy will destroy them. However, there is the issue of time... We are almost out of it.
If I hadn't stopped your passage through the astral, you would have ended up at the Wandering Island, whose appearance had disrupted the ancient portal network's operation.
My faithful followers, stigmatized as cultists by nearsighted fools, have already arrived at the Wandering Island, which contains the last portal to the Dead City. Alas, traitors arrived there first and with greater numbers. My warriors are strong, but even they cannot best the enemy with a single stroke.
I know why the traitors are seeking to enter the Dead City. And Nihaz knows it, too. And I bet the last thing he wants is for wormfaces and draconids to carry out their plan.
So, I offer a truce to your Master. A temporary one, to be sure. Sooner or later we shall meet in battle. But until then we must ally ourselves to wipe out the draconids, the wormfaces and whoever is pulling their strings. It's not the mortals' place to try and attain things beyond their capacity.
Pass this message to your Master. He will understand. And perhaps one day you will understand that conflict and hatred are not one and the same. Conflict is merely one of the many states of the ever-changing reality.

Marianna Lopatina's Log.

June 23, 1018

I'm a pirates' captive! This is so exciting!

Found several new tablets in Takalik Harbor. Since I'm imprisoned in this stinky cargo hold anyway, I have time to continue translating tablets from the June language.

"Oh, glorious June Itsmal! Oh, great cities of Uskul and Miktlan! They have fallen to the fury of the June Curse. There's no escape. The curse cannot be lifted. There's nowhere to run. Almost all golems have been shattered. The portal network is destroyed.

We have only one way out left. The Dark promised us salvation. He was the one to warn us about danger. If we'd killed treacherous Sheratan, the last Fire Dragon, the world could split in two, like a giant egg.

Wise Shilonen, Coatl, and Atslan want to seek assistance with him. There are those who oppose. Tka-a-Lithan Ric-ti-a-Nic, also known as Bane of the Fire Dragons, does not trust the Dark. He suggests we return to the city and use the old portals."

The note stops abruptly. I hope I can steal the key when the goblin brings food.

Bloody captain!

The June treasure will do us no good, no doubt!

I hear, Junes are cursed people. They brought demons to our world.

Captain shouldn't have gotten involved...

Bloody captain!

We got in a dirty game. Here's how it happened. We made it to a port and got ashore. First thing we did was go down to the tavern. There was this fat bearded man in boots. Couldn't put down his newspaper.

So, he spotted our captain, beckoned him with a finger, and offered a good price for that crazy girl jumping about the ruins.

Captain was going to say no, but the money clouded his mind, his eyes lit up! He couldn't turn it down.

Oh, these June heritage lovers!

Everybody's needy of this junk like crazy. Everybody wants something new.

We got this order from Simon Suslangerer. He wanted the June crystals, whatever they are. We had to scrounge around for a week, running away from trolls. They don't give a damn what they eat. One of them caught Mum Bad Ear, and the cracking bones was the last we heard. Finally, we delivered the crystals to the Great Mage.

Just as we were going to leave, Antoinette de Delice from Ignis sent a messenger, asking, and I quote, "My dear sailors, bring me some obsidian blades." Which means, we get to dig dirt to collect them. Here are you blades, your Mageness.

We stored some for ourselves, though.  There's still plenty left in the ruins. Especially in hidden stashes.

There's an unusual place somewhere in the Astral. The place where the Junes once fought two Great Dragons.

Having defeated most of the dragons, the Junes began to chase the remaining dragons around the world. Their sea vessels carrying mighty golems moved incredibly fast with magic. And the Dragon Hunters themselves were equally mighty.

And so the fleet ran down the two strongest dragons, the Great Dragons Tegmin and Rukbat. It was a great battle. The Junes suffered huge losses, but managed to win.

Such creatures have so much magic accumulated in them that their death takes it toll. The last outburst of dragons' magic power froze a whole ocean! The cataclysm that happened later has split the world in two, but the dragon's hearts kept the icy ocean intact. The magic charm has turned the ocean into the two winged monsters' burial vault, wandering in astral.

For centuries, this place was hidden from people's eyes until a pirate expedition came across the snow-covered dragon skeletons. The astral forces were eating away at the ice, exposing the secret lying underneath. Even beyond death the dragons' hearts are bleeding. The blood itself possesses some magical qualities. A Great Mage that drinks it will become immortal.

Although ordinary people have no idea, the icy allod immediately attracted the Treasure Hunters' attention.

The pirates are prepared for anything to get into the icy tomb...
